Hi Signe — thanks for the invoice and the clear questions. Answers below and our wire fields attached as a quick template.

1) Preferred currency: EUR SEPA to our EUR account is preferred (no FX conversion, faster clearing). If your Treasury can only send USD, we can accept USD to our US account but please note additional correspondent bank hops may apply.

2) Fees: Our standard commercial policy for enterprise invoices is to receive the invoice net of all banking charges — i.e., we request an OUR instruction where possible so the payer covers all intermediary and correspondent bank fees. If your bank cannot send OUR on the selected corridor, please send SHA but note that intermediary fees deducted en route will be treated as deductions from the invoice amount. In those cases we will:
  - reconcile any material shortfalls (> €25) and either issue a small supplementary invoice or credit the shortage on the next statement, depending on your preference;
  - include the payment trace/reference so we can reconcile quickly.

3) VAT: We apply reverse-charge for B2B EU customers when we have a valid VAT registration number on file. Please send your VAT number (and VAT certificate if available) to accounts@nordicdata.com and cc us; once we have that we confirm the invoice footer and keep records for audit.

Quick note on VAT and reconciliation workflow from finance — welcome to loop me into the payment thread so we can close this cleanly. A few practicals: 

- If NordicData is an EU-registered business and provides a VAT number, we will apply reverse charge (0% on our invoice) and record the VAT number in our ledger. Please send the VAT ID and a short certificate or screenshot from your national VAT portal where possible.
- If payment arrives with intermediary fees deducted (SHA), please provide the payment advice showing gross amount sent, the actual amount received, and the trace code (payment reference). That will allow us to net-book the shortfall efficiently.
